name: Cache Library
description: In-memory TTL cache used for configuration and session data
change_description: Reduce DEFAULT_TTL from 300s to 60s to get fresher data more frequently
diff:
--- a/cache_lib/cache.py
+++ b/cache_lib/cache.py
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ from typing import Any, Optional
 
 # THIS IS THE VALUE UNDER CHANGE
 # Scenario: reduce default TTL from 300s to 60s for "fresher" data.
-DEFAULT_TTL = 300  # seconds — entries live for 5 minutes by default
+DEFAULT_TTL = 60   # seconds — entries live for 1 minute by default
 
 
 class TTLCache:
key_insight: The ConfigCache inherits DEFAULT_TTL. Tests check the exact value (300) and the logical invariant (TTL > 61s) that an integration test depends on. The integration test (slow) would sleep 61s and find entries expired.
